summary: Connect personnel processes with practical staff development using job analysis, ADDIE and learning evaluation. Review the course outline.
lede: Human resources development and personnel management connect employee administration with practical staff development. For HR officers, personnel administrators and line managers, the course focuses on coordinating employee processes and planning capability-building around job needs. You practise job analysis and structured selection, create learning plans with ADDIE, and use the Kirkpatrick Four Levels to evaluate learning and follow-up.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits people who administer employee processes or coordinate staff development and want to connect routine HR work with usable outputs. It is designed for these roles:
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: No prior HR qualification is specified. The course suits foundation-level learners; no coding or programming is required.
